Update an existing knowledge graph index

Usage: graphloom update [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -r, --root <ROOT>
          Project root directory

          [default: .]

  -m, --method <METHOD>
          Indexing method

          Possible values:
          - standard: Standard full indexing pipeline

          [default: standard]

  -v, --verbose
          Print more detailed progress

      --cache
          Use LLM cache for this run

      --no-cache
          Disable LLM cache for this run

      --skip-validation
          Skip optional external-resource preflight checks

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
